name: analysis-kit
description: Session analysis toolkit for Claude Code: component retrospectives, tool/framework auditing, actor behavior analysis, goal/outcome attainment, verification-effectiveness auditing, operational reliability and performance, workflow usability and friction, security/privacy threat modeling, governance and conflict detection, session/specification comparison, recurring-pattern mining, evidence-backed feature-opportunity identification, recommendation-lifecycle tracking, cross-report findings review, classified improvement recommendations, and third-party review-learnings mining/management — grounded in a session, date range, a set of merged PRs, or a specific tracked recommendation, with reports persisted for later reference, a guided front door to pick the right analysis type without needing to already know the other skills' names, and a multi-run orchestrator that consolidates several analyses into one prioritized action list and hands off to a guided fix pass.
